summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2004-2 filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that Navient Solutions, LLC, as administrator, provided a preliminary remarketing memorandum for the Trust's Class A-6 Reset Rate Notes to qualified institutional buyers. The filing attaches pool statistics as of May 31, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. This is a routine remarketing update for an asset-backed security trust, disclosing current pool information per continuing disclosure obligations under the indenture. No deal terms, premium, or board action exist. There is no risk-arb angle or unusual event to monitor; the filing solely satisfies regulatory requirements for ongoing ABS reporting.
